title: Portland City Lights and Tiki Nights 1-Hour River Cruise
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Life jackets are available on board for kids 12 and under.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
**City Lights & Tiki Nights Cruise – Tiki, Tunes & Waterfront Views**

Step aboard for Portland's most unique evening escape: the City Lights & Tiki Nights Cruise. This 21+ one-hour cruise along the Willamette River combines the fun of a floating lounge with views of the city skyline sparkling against the night sky. Sip your favorite drink as you glide past glowing bridges and the illuminated waterfront while music and social vibes set the mood.

Every cruise is unique as the vibe tends to align with the energy of the group onboard, often ending in one big dance party. Whether you're planning a date, celebrating a special occasion, simply gathering with friends, or looking for a new way to enjoy Portland after dark, this cruise blends scenic views with lively island-style energy.

**August:** 9:30 PM check-in, 10–11 PM cruise. **September & October:** Usually 8:00 PM check-in, 8:30–9:30 PM cruise. Please review all booking details and communications carefully before your cruise.
